About me

Hi, I'm glad you're here.

I'm a Board-Certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner with over a decade of experience providing compassionate, evidence-based mental healthcare. I prioritize creating a safe and affirming environment for every client, with a focus on person-centered care.

Using a combination of medication management, education and therapy, I partner with clients on treatment plans tailored to their needs, goals and long-term healing.

I aim for collaboration, transparency and shared decision-making, helping you weigh medication options while building resilience and self-compassion.

Getting started

What to expect.

Book on Headway

Pick a time on my Headway page. Headway also handles insurance and billing.

Your first session

We'll go over your reasons for scheduling, your current symptoms, daily life, mental and physical health, and past care.

Build your plan

Together we create a plan that may include medication support, therapy, goal setting, mindfulness or lifestyle shifts.

Sessions are 60 minutes over Zoom. If you're prescribed a controlled substance, a yearly in-person appointment may be required.

Insurance & fees

Using your insurance.

Billing is handled through Headway. Add your insurance on my Headway page to see an estimate of your session cost.

Aetna Ascension Carelon Behavioral Health Cigna Curative

Private pay is available if you don't have insurance, your plan isn't accepted, or you'd rather not use it. Medicare and Medicaid plans aren't eligible for private pay through Headway.

Questions about private pay or moving your care to Headway? Email hello@sample-practice.example.

Questions

Frequently asked.

Are sessions in person or online?

Sessions are online over Zoom. If you're prescribed a controlled substance, a yearly in-person appointment may be required.

Do I need to live in Michigan?

Yes. I'm licensed in Michigan and see clients who are located in the state.

Do you prescribe medication?

Yes. As a psychiatric nurse practitioner, I provide psychiatric assessment and medication management, and I also offer therapy.

How do I schedule?

Book a time on my Headway page. Headway also handles insurance and billing.

How long are sessions?

Sessions are 60 minutes.

Can I pay without insurance?

Yes, private pay is available through Headway. Medicare and Medicaid plans aren't eligible for private pay through Headway.

Do you work with teens?

Yes. I see clients from older adolescence through older adulthood.
